title: Tracking Entanglement Transfer: Emergence of Thermodynamics from Quantum Information
summary: We study entanglement transfer in a minimal model of two qubits that are coupled with one another through an antiferromagnetic Heisenberg exchange ($\tilde{J}$), and where one of them is additionally coupled to a fermionic environment through another antiferromagnetic Heisenberg exchange ($J_{K}$). By tuning the coupling ratio $J_{K}/\tilde{J}$, the system undergoes a quantum phase transition at $T=0$, accompanied by a redistribution of entanglement from the $d'-d$ qubit-subsystem to the environment.
